verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows no first-party natural-language interface or AI assistant for operating Unreal Engine. The control surfaces documented are programmatic: Python editor scripting, the Remote Control HTTP/WebSocket API, and command-line arguments. The probe finds no official Epic MCP server, and the community MCP bridges it mentions are third-party and unmaintained since 2025, so they do not show the product delivers natural-language operation.
